sources.note: Original 50,000-iteration cloud run. Computation window verified from the 48 simulation steps: https://github.com/laurencestokes/foreversim/actions/runs/40545126193. All non-Troll rows are preserved.

Complete local 50,000-iteration Troll rerun after Berserking changed to 15 seconds. The raw rows record this engine revision; their exact computation time was not recorded. The date shown is the combined matrix scoring time.

compatibility.method: All 34 original serialized players and snapshots matched current presets after five Mage display-label changes and verification that all removed or renumbered sheet-only pseudostat slots are zero. Combat source and game-data comparison found no further behavior changes. Old and merged engines produced exactly equal unrounded DPS and standard errors across 2,025 matchups at two iterations and 333 melee-focused matchups at 256 iterations. Published values remain the original 50,000-iteration estimates. Requests retain the original serialized players.
